lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Rectilinear grid arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized in vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows to form localized high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edge and shadow-induced lower boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Transient high-luminance caustic network (refraction patterns) overlaid across the dorsal and upper-flank region.
